name: Odaka Kousuke
source:
Kousuke is the husband of [url=https://vndb.org/c57227]Chinatsu[/url] and the protagonist of the game.

After a fire burns down their appartment, his boss, [url=https://vndb.org/c57230]Kaizuka Hidetaka[/url] and his housewife [url=https://vndb.org/c57229]Fumiko[/url] offer to let them stay with them until they can find a new appartment.
